result.title: A Living Leaderboard for Graph Machine Learning
result.comment: The leaderboard is available at https://graphlearningbenchmarks.github.io , the code at https://github.com/martinalex000/benchmarking_website
result.summary: Graph machine learning benchmarking results are scattered across papers that use quite different sets of datasets and baseline methods, making it difficult to tell whether a reported gain reflects architectural progress or merely an outdated comparison or weakly tuned baseline. We introduce a living, graph-learning-specific leaderboard that organizes reported results by dataset, putting new results into context. As of 15 October 2026 our LLM-based extraction pipeline extracted 27,723 eligible results across 111 datasets from 885 peer-reviewed papers. Our analysis of these results quantifies concerns about graph-learning benchmarking: legacy datasets are still actively used and many result tables contain baseline results that are drastically lower than those already available in the literature, e.g. 45% Amazon-ratings tables and 37% for Peptides-struct. The leaderboard allows to quickly compare new results against compatible prior results, aiming to improve the overall quality of graph learning benchmarking.

AI.brief_summary: 构建图机器学习的动态排行榜：用 LLM 从 885 篇同行评审论文中抽取 27,723 条结果，按 111 个数据集组织已报告结果，并据此量化基准比较中的陈旧基线与选择性对标问题。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但「把新结果放入可用历史结果上下文、检验基线是否被弱调」的做法可能为视觉推理基准中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 收益的归因与可比性核查提供参考。
